manifest.scope: Stress controls on known development cases; NOT independent clinical validation

v1.1.note: Heuristic research ranking; not calibrated probabilities or clinical ACMG classification. Missing component contributes no support; weights are not renormalized.

v1.2.note: Heuristic ranking, not calibrated probability or ACMG classification. Molecular support=max(0.55*prediction, established functional effect, reviewed condition-specific ClinVar)+0.15*rarity. Dependent support is not summed; unknown evidence is not benign. Outer weights and decision thresholds unchanged.

molecular.scope: Heuristic prioritization; no calibrated probability, LR or automatic ACMG codes

limitations: Known labels are used only to construct targeted controls and evaluate results.
Added HPO terms are artificial perturbations, not verified patient findings.
Deleted causal variant does not establish a clinically negative case.
No threshold or evidence curation is changed in response to this run.
